title: A股港股早报：开盘科技走弱，政策托底未能抵消成长压力
summary: 09:42 CST，创业板跌2.43%、恒生科技跌1.28%，光迅科技与德明利分别跌3.54%和2.25%；MLF与高增业绩仍在，但首轮期指反弹未获本地量价确认，短线转向防守与等待修复。

MLF投放AI就业政策存储业绩油气高位激光雷达网络安全光通信国产算力电信压力指数新规A股弱宽度港股分化
利好利空中性w1-w5 表示热度/重要性，不等于涨跌幅。
重大新闻汇总
国际
中东袭击延续，原油从近六个月高位回吐
周末胡塞武装继续袭击沙特机场和石油设施；周一08:18 CST，WTI报101.67美元、跌1.55%，Brent报115.16美元、跌1.34%。油价回落缓解边际通胀压力，但供应风险尚未解除。
政策
央行今日开展7000亿元一年期MLF操作
中国人民银行10月23日公告，为保持银行体系流动性充裕，10月26日以固定数量、利率招标、多重价位中标方式开展7000亿元MLF；利好流动性预期，价格仍取决于中标利率。
政策
国务院部署AI发展与就业友好型转型
10月24日公开的国办发〔2026〕29号提出AI中小企业创业支持、开源社区、智能终端制造与专项培训，同时要求评估就业替代风险；对软件、算力与终端是政策支撑，也带来合规约束。
交易所
上证系列综合指数编制修订今日实施
上交所修订规则增加单个样本15%权重上限，并调整风险警示证券剔除时间；今日实施，可能改变权重股和风险警示证券的被动资金扰动。
美股
油气链领涨而电信服务承压
10月23日Moomoo行业榜显示油气钻探+6.15%、油服+4.94%；Reuters显示能源板块涨2.5%。电信服务行业跌3.16%，AT&T和T-Mobile因SpaceX潜在第四家运营商竞争均跌近8%；A/H能源映射偏正面，运营商冲击更多是美国特有竞争结构。
美股
激光雷达、网络安全与存储概念走强
概念榜中激光雷达+5.78%（LIDR +10.41%）、网络安全+4.55%（SAIL +8.62%）、存储+2.19%（SKHY +4.05%）；对应A/H智能驾驶、安全软件和存储链，但周一期指反弹尚无代表股夜盘逐项报价确认。
产业
智元开源真实场景具身推理数据集
盘前发现源显示智元发布AGIBOT WORLD 2026第四期，覆盖九类真实推理场景与动作轨迹；利好机器人数据与训练生态，但未见上市公司订单或收入确认，不直接形成个股卡。
业绩
德明利三季度营收与利润大幅增长
巨潮披露显示单季营收116.45亿元、同比+356.64%，归母净利润27.29亿元、同比+2902.75%，企业级存储收入占比提升；09:41 CST报245.34元、跌2.25%，盘中低至239.28元，强业绩未获得开盘确认。
业绩
寒武纪三季度收入利润双增
公司三季报显示单季营收35.31亿元、同比+104.47%，归母净利润14.04亿元、同比+147.74%；09:41 CST报930.41元、跌0.19%，盘中低至908.10元；相对抗跌但存货上升与第三季度经营现金流转负仍构成反证。
业绩
光迅科技三季度归母净利润翻倍
公司披露单季营收50.73亿元、同比+54.27%，归母净利润7.02亿元、同比+102.62%；09:41 CST报124.08元、跌3.54%且接近日内低点，强业绩未能抵消开盘抛压。
港股
东山精密H股发行价确定
港交所公告线索显示H股发行价定为86.80港元，预计10月28日主板挂牌；融资强化国际化平台，但新增股份、估值与上市后波动需要跟踪。

美股夜盘行情总结

夜盘
夜盘指数转强
约08:25 CST，道指、标普500、纳指100期货分别+0.34%、+0.48%、+0.66%；行情来自盘前公开市场快讯，属于延迟盘初快照。
对照
期指反弹与周五板块强弱形成背离
行业Top5/Bottom5及概念Top5代表股逐项查询：NE、RHI、TDW、TPET、HCC、OPTU、SNFCA、EPOW、AIRE、SMJF、LIDR、SAIL、APA、DVN、SKHY均未取得可核验夜盘成交，因此不以周五收盘替代；指数层面偏强但个股层面不可得，结论为背离而非确认。
映射
本地开盘否定期指反弹映射
截至09:42 CST，创业板跌2.43%、恒生科技跌1.28%，上证和恒指亦未站稳前收；MLF与业绩催化仍在，但隔夜期指反弹未转化为A/H风险偏好，短线由进攻转为防守与等待修复。

开盘结论

7000亿元MLF与三只科技股高增业绩仍是中期支撑。 但09:42创业板跌2.43%、恒科跌1.28%，光迅与德明利均显著低于前收，开盘量价否定了首轮的修复确认路径。
短线判断下调为防守：优先高股息、油气和低波动方向，科技只观察相对强弱与修复。 若创业板/恒科收复跌幅且光迅、德明利回到前收附近，才重新评估进攻性配置。

重点个股关注

德明利
SZ.001309
等待修复
事实与状态：三季度业绩高增，但09:41报245.34元、跌2.25%，盘中低至239.28元；公告后首个交易时段未获正反馈。
重新确认：先收复251.00元前收并稳定半小时，同时存储板块跌幅收敛。
风险与失效：若反弹仍不能收复前收或再破239.28元日低，继续回避追高；强业绩不得替代负面价格反馈。
光迅科技
SZ.002281
暂时回避
事实与状态：三季度归母净利润翻倍，但09:41报124.08元、跌3.54%且接近124.01元日低，业绩催化被抛压压制。
重新确认：先回到128.63元前收上方，且通信设备板块同步止跌。
风险与失效：若跌破124.01元或持续弱于板块，维持回避；不得把高增财报包装成即时多头信号。
寒武纪
SH.688256
中性观察
事实与状态：09:41报930.41元、跌0.19%，相对创业板和恒科抗跌，但盘中曾低见908.10元，波动仍高。
重新确认：站稳932.20元前收且国产算力板块跌幅收敛，才恢复条件关注。
风险与失效：存货与现金流反证未消除；若再破908.10元日低或相对强势消失，转为回避。

板块轮动看板

相对受益
高股息、油气和低波动防守方向；科技成长开盘走弱后不宜追高。
等待修复
存储、光通信与国产算力仍有业绩支撑，但需先收复关键前收并看到板块跌幅收敛。
压力方向
高估值成长、通信设备与恒生科技；期指上涨未能转化为本地风险偏好。
验证信号
创业板与恒科显著收窄跌幅，德明利重返251元、光迅重返128.63元，寒武纪稳于932.20元上方。

逻辑链

08:25美股期指上行原本提供风险偏好缓和假设，但09:42创业板跌2.43%、恒科跌1.28%，本地开盘未确认。
7000亿元MLF和AI就业政策仍提供流动性与产业支撑，却不足以抵消上一交易时段弱宽度与成长抛压。
德明利和光迅分别跌2.25%和3.54%，说明强业绩短线已被价格负反馈压过；寒武纪跌0.19%仅属相对抗跌。
在指数与重点股收复关键前收前，策略从结构性进攻切换为防守；后续若量价修复再上调判断。

风险雷达

创业板跌2.43%、恒科跌1.28%，科技成长开盘抛压已成为当前首要风险。
光迅与德明利在高增财报后分别跌3.54%和2.25%，不得把基本面利好包装成即时多头信号。
寒武纪盘中低见908.10元，虽相对抗跌但波动与存货、现金流反证仍高。
中东供应风险仍可能推动油价反弹，并重新抬升通胀与利率压力。

数据来源与时间点

首轮来源与基线保持不变：Moomoo排行快照（2026-10-24 07:52 CST，对应10月23日美股现金时段）、Reuters美股收盘/油价、AKShare 1.18.94（2026-10-23 12:51 CST，仅作上一交易时段盘中基线；A股642涨/4872跌/59平、中位-3.358%，港股799涨/867跌/1139平、中位0%），以及央行/新华社、国务院、中国政府网、上交所、巨潮、公司公告与HKEX。增量核验：东方财富实时行情页于09:41 CST显示上证3673.42/-0.46%、创业板2618.90/-2.43%、恒指23071.26/-0.10%，德明利245.34/-2.25%、寒武纪930.41/-0.19%、光迅科技124.08/-3.54%；雪球恒生科技页于09:42 CST显示3822.08/-1.28%。08:44后定向检查未发现足以改变判断的新增政策或交易所/HKEX重要公告。

Major News Summary
Global
Middle East attacks persist as oil retreats from a near six-month high
Houthi attacks on Saudi airports and oil facilities continued over the weekend. At 08:18 CST Monday, WTI was $101.67, down 1.55%, and Brent $115.16, down 1.34%. The pullback eases marginal inflation pressure, but supply risk remains.
Policy
PBOC conducts RMB700bn of one-year MLF today
The central bank said on Oct 23 it would conduct RMB700bn of one-year MLF on Oct 26 through fixed quantity, rate bidding and multiple-price awards. This supports liquidity expectations; the clearing rate remains the key price signal.
Policy
State Council links AI development with employment-friendly transition
Document No. 29, published Oct 24, supports AI entrepreneurship, open-source communities, smart-terminal manufacturing and training while requiring assessments of job displacement. It supports software, compute and devices but adds compliance constraints.
Exchange
Revised Shanghai composite methodology takes effect today
The SSE adds a 15% cap for a single constituent and changes the removal timing for risk-warning securities. The effective date is today, potentially altering passive-flow effects in heavyweights and flagged stocks.
US
Oil and gas led while telecom services lagged
Moomoo’s Oct 23 industry table showed Oil & Gas Drilling +6.15% and Oilfield Services +4.94%; Reuters put energy +2.5%. Telecom Services fell 3.16%, while AT&T and T-Mobile each lost nearly 8% on possible SpaceX competition. The energy read-through is positive for A/H, but the telecom shock is largely US-specific.
US
Lidar, cybersecurity and storage concepts strengthened
Lidar rose 5.78% (LIDR +10.41%), Cybersecurity 4.55% (SAIL +8.62%) and Storage 2.19% (SKHY +4.05%). These map to A/H smart driving, security software and memory, but representative overnight quotes are unavailable despite firmer Monday futures.
Industry
AgiBot opens a real-world embodied reasoning dataset
A domestic morning discovery source says AGIBOT WORLD 2026 Phase IV covers nine real-world reasoning categories with action trajectories. This helps robotics data and training ecosystems, but no listed-company order or revenue confirmation was found, so no stock card is created.
Earnings
Techwinsemi posts sharp quarterly revenue and profit growth
The CNInfo filing shows quarterly revenue of RMB11.645bn, up 356.64%, and attributable net profit of RMB2.729bn, up 2,902.75%, with enterprise storage gaining mix. At 09:41 CST it traded at CNY245.34, down 2.25%, after touching CNY239.28; strong earnings failed the opening confirmation test.
Earnings
Cambricon doubles quarterly revenue and profit
The quarterly report shows revenue of RMB3.531bn, up 104.47%, and attributable net profit of RMB1.404bn, up 147.74%. At 09:41 CST it traded at CNY930.41, down 0.19%, after touching CNY908.10; relative resilience is offset by higher inventory and negative third-quarter operating cash flow.
Earnings
Accelink doubles quarterly attributable profit
The filing shows quarterly revenue of RMB5.073bn, up 54.27%, and attributable net profit of RMB702m, up 102.62%. At 09:41 CST it traded at CNY124.08, down 3.54% and near the session low; strong earnings failed to offset opening selling pressure.
Hong Kong
Dongshan Precision fixes its H-share offer price
An HKEX announcement trail shows an offer price of HKD86.80 and expected Main Board trading on Oct 28. The listing broadens the funding platform, while dilution, valuation and post-listing volatility require monitoring.

US Overnight Trading Summary

Overnight
Index futures strengthened
Around 08:25 CST, Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures were +0.34%, +0.48% and +0.66%. The figures came from a public premarket briefing and are a delayed early snapshot.
Cross-check
Futures diverged from Friday's sector tape
Representative names across Industry Top 5/Bottom 5 and Concept Top 5—NE, RHI, TDW, TPET, HCC, OPTU, SNFCA, EPOW, AIRE, SMJF, LIDR, SAIL, APA, DVN and SKHY—had no verifiable overnight prints. Friday closes were not substituted; index strength remained a divergence, not confirmation.
Read-through
The A/H open rejected the futures-led rebound
By 09:42 CST, ChiNext was down 2.43% and HSTECH 1.28%, while Shanghai and Hang Seng also failed to hold prior closes. MLF support and earnings catalysts remain, but overnight futures did not translate into local risk appetite; the near-term stance shifts from offense to defense and repair.

Opening Takeaway

The RMB700bn MLF and strong growth from the three technology names remain medium-term support. But at 09:42 CST ChiNext was down 2.43%, HSTECH 1.28%, and both Accelink and Techwinsemi traded materially below prior closes, invalidating the first-run rebound confirmation path.
The near-term stance is downgraded to defense: prefer high dividend, oil and gas, and lower-volatility groups, while treating technology as a repair watch. Reassess offense only if ChiNext/HSTECH recover and Accelink/Techwinsemi return near prior closes.

Focused Stocks

Techwinsemi
SZ.001309
Wait for Repair
Facts and status: Third-quarter growth was strong, but the stock traded at CNY245.34, down 2.25%, at 09:41 CST after touching CNY239.28. The first post-filing session delivered negative price feedback.
Reconfirmation: First reclaim the CNY251.00 prior close for at least half an hour while the storage group narrows losses.
Risk and invalidation: If a rebound still fails to regain the prior close or the stock breaks CNY239.28, avoid chasing. Strong earnings do not override negative price action.
Accelink Technologies
SZ.002281
Avoid for Now
Facts and status: Quarterly attributable profit doubled, but the stock traded at CNY124.08, down 3.54%, at 09:41 CST and remained near the CNY124.01 session low.
Reconfirmation: Reclaim the CNY128.63 prior close while communication equipment stabilizes.
Risk and invalidation: A break below CNY124.01 or persistent sector underperformance keeps the stance at Avoid. The strong report is not an immediate bullish signal.
Cambricon
SH.688256
Neutral Watch
Facts and status: At 09:41 CST it traded at CNY930.41, down 0.19%, outperforming ChiNext and HSTECH, though the CNY908.10 session low shows elevated volatility.
Reconfirmation: Hold above the CNY932.20 prior close as the domestic AI-compute group narrows losses before restoring a conditional watch.
Risk and invalidation: Inventory and cash-flow counterevidence remain. A renewed break below CNY908.10 or loss of relative strength turns the stance to Avoid.

Sector Rotation Board

Relative Beneficiaries
High dividend, oil and gas, and lower-volatility defense. Do not chase growth technology after the weak open.
Wait for Repair
Storage, optical communications and domestic AI compute retain earnings support, but must first reclaim key prior closes as sector losses narrow.
Pressure
High-multiple growth, communication equipment and HSTECH. Stronger futures did not translate into local risk appetite.
Validation
ChiNext and HSTECH narrow losses materially; Techwinsemi regains CNY251, Accelink CNY128.63, and Cambricon holds above CNY932.20.

Logic Chain

The 08:25 CST rise in US futures suggested easier risk sentiment, but ChiNext -2.43% and HSTECH -1.28% by 09:42 failed to confirm it locally.
RMB700bn MLF and the AI employment policy still support liquidity and industry, but did not offset prior-session weak breadth and growth selling.
Techwinsemi -2.25% and Accelink -3.54% show negative price feedback overwhelming strong earnings; Cambricon -0.19% is only relative resilience.
Until indices and focus stocks reclaim key prior closes, the strategy shifts from structural offense to defense; upgrade only after price-and-volume repair.

Risk Radar

ChiNext -2.43% and HSTECH -1.28% make opening selling in growth technology the primary current risk.
Accelink and Techwinsemi fell 3.54% and 2.25% after strong reports; fundamentals must not be repackaged as immediate bullish signals.
Cambricon touched CNY908.10. Relative resilience does not remove its volatility, inventory and cash-flow counterevidence.
Middle East supply risk can reaccelerate oil, inflation and rate pressure.

Sources and Timestamps

First-run sources and baselines remain unchanged: the Moomoo rankings snapshot at 2026-10-24 07:52 CST for the Oct 23 US cash session, Reuters for the US close and oil, AKShare 1.18.94 at 2026-10-23 12:51 CST as a prior-session intraday baseline only (A shares 642 up/4,872 down/59 flat, median -3.358%; Hong Kong 799 up/867 down/1,139 flat, median 0%), plus PBOC/Xinhua, the State Council/China Government, SSE, CNInfo, company filings and HKEX. Incremental checks: Eastmoney live quote pages at 09:41 CST showed Shanghai 3673.42/-0.46%, ChiNext 2618.90/-2.43%, Hang Seng 23071.26/-0.10%, Techwinsemi 245.34/-2.25%, Cambricon 930.41/-0.19% and Accelink 124.08/-3.54%; Xueqiu showed HSTECH 3822.08/-1.28% at 09:42 CST. Targeted checks found no post-08:44 policy or exchange/HKEX announcement material enough to alter the view.
